script: So um the car — wait, first the tire looked low this morning, maybe flat, but then it started fine, then at the light it almost stalled, and I thought battery? Or alternator? There was a click yesterday. Also the check engine light blinked once then stopped. I am on the shoulder of Route 9. Spare is there. Jump pack is at home. Do I call a tow or try to limp to the gas station a mile away?
